ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") made as of the 22?day of 2h0 June, 2012 by and between CENTRAL PARK SOUTH ASSOCIATES, L.L.C., a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Omnispective Management Corp., 240 Central             Delaware limited liability company having an office at c/o Extell Development Company, 805 Third Avenue, 7"h Floor, New York, New York 10022 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner represents that it is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, which land and improvements lie below a horizontal plane (the“Lower Limiting Plane") drawn at an elevation of two thousand three hundred eighty four (2,384) feet above the datum used by the Topographic Bureau of the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan,(whichis 2.75 feet above theUnited States Coast and Geodetic Survey mean sea level datum, Sandy Hook, New Jersey) ("Datum Level"), located in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address as 240 Central Park South, New York, NewYork,designated asTaxLot58inBlock1030on theTaxMapof theCity,County andState of New York (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively called the “Owner Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto not prohibited pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building,"” and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the "OwnerPremises"); WHEREAS,the Owner Building has been designated by the New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission (the "LPC"), pursuant to Section 25-303(a)(1) of the New York City Administrative Code, as a “landmark"; WHEREAS,Developer acquired from the Owner by deed (the “Airspace Deed") dated ofevendateherewiththevolumeof airwhichlies abovetheLowerLimitingPlane,located within the boundaries of the Owner Land and part of Tax Lot 58 in Block 1030 on the Tax Map (as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof, being herein called the “Airspace Premises"), so that on the date hereof Owner is the owner in fee of the Owner Premises and Developer is the owner in fee of the Airspace Premises; WHEREAS,by execution of a Declaration of Restrictions of even date and contemporaneously herewith (the “Restrictive Declaration") and recorded in the Conveyances Section of the Office of the City Register for New York County against the land known as Tax Lot 17 in Block 1030 on the Tax Map (the “Lot 17 Land"), Developer has agreed that any conveyance of fee title to the Lot 17 Land shall include the simultaneous conveyance of fee title to the Airspace Premises to the party acquiring fee title to the Lot 17 Land so that the fee owner of the Lot17 Landisthefeeownerof theAirspacePremises;
